Trump, whose approval rating has held at a record low amid concerns of high cost of living spurred by soaring gasoline and diesel prices, has offered [USN:L4N4061X8 TEXT:"shifting timelines and goals"] for the war.

item.title: Grupo Primo faz fusão com Oikos Wealth Management
item.description: O Grupo Primo anunciou nesta terça-feira fusão com a gestora de fortunas Oikos Wealth Management, elevando o total de recursos sob administração da empresa para R$34 bilhões.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Grupo Primo anunciou nesta terça-feira fusão com a gestora de fortunas Oikos Wealth Management, elevando o total de recursos sob administração da empresa para R$34 bilhões. O grupo tem meta de alcançar R$100 bilhões sob gestão até 2028 e com a aquisição, a empresa passa a contar com os sócios da Oikos, Fernanda Raimo, Rafael Medeiros, Eduardo Ruske e Renato Mendes, segundo comunicado à imprensa. Com o negócio, o grupo ingressa no mercado de clientes "private", com patrimônio entre R$20 milhões e R$100 milhões, e acima disso, segundo o documento, que não informa o volume de recursos administrados pela companhia antes da operação. "Embora tenhamos a meta de R$100 bilhões até 2028, não buscamos apenas ativos sob gestão. Buscamos sócios, capital humano de altíssimo nível, com currículo e cultura compatíveis... A Oikos é exatamente isso", afirmou o presidente-executivo do Grupo Primo, Fernando Vasconcellos, no comunicado.

item.title: BOJ's dovish dissenter signals support for future rate hikes
item.description: The Bank of Japan's new policymaker Ayano Sato said she supports the idea of raising interest rates in several stages, Kyodo news agency reported on Wednesday, highlighting awareness even among dovish board members of the need to combat inflation risks.
item.dc:creator: Leika Kihara
item.content:encoded: The Bank of Japan's new policymaker Ayano Sato said she supports the idea of raising interest rates in several stages, Kyodo news agency reported on Wednesday, highlighting awareness even among dovish board members of the need to combat inflation risks. Appointed by Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, who favours looser monetary policy, Sato was one of two dissenters to the BOJ's decision to raise interest rates in [USN:L1N459138 TEXT:"September"]. She joined the nine-member board in June. In the interview with Kyodo, Sato said she decided to vote against last month's rate hike because consumption lacked momentum and underlying inflation was not picking up pace. "I support the idea that interest rates should be adjusted in stages, as current financial conditions are accommodative," Sato was quoted as saying, adding that the appropriate timing of future rate hikes would depend on developments in consumption and income. Sato also said there should not be any pre-set pace for future rate hikes, according to Kyodo. Risks to the price outlook were "somewhat skewed to the upside" due to rising crude oil prices linked to the Middle East conflict, Sato said. INFLATION APPROACHING 2% Along with Toichiro Asada, another newcomer appointed by Takaichi, Sato has been seen by markets as among doves on the nine-member board who could continue to vote against rate hikes. Their dissents in September pushed down the yen as market players interpreted the move as a sign the BOJ's rate-hike plans would continue to face opposition from Takaichi's administration. Sato told Kyodo that BOJ rate hikes could contribute to achieving sustained economic growth. The central bank would set policy independently, but in a way that "eventually aligns with the administration's proactive fiscal policy," she said. After spending years treading cautiously in policy normalisation, the BOJ picked up pace in raising rates by hiking in June and September as the Iran war-induced energy shock added to price pressures from rising import costs via a weak yen. Upon hiking rates to a 31-year high of 1.25% in September, Governor Kazuo Ueda said the central bank had entered a phase focused on preventing underlying inflation from overshooting its target, raising the prospect of tighter policy. While the BOJ may pause in October, it is likely to drop hawkish hints that would reinforce dominant market expectations of a December hike, [USN:L4N45S011 TEXT:"sources have told Reuters"]. In a separate interview with the daily Asahi newspaper, Sato said underlying inflation was approaching the BOJ's 2% target, adding that her views on monetary policy were "not that different from many others in the board."

item.title: C.H. Robinson CEO sees more freight broker consolidation as diesel costs bite
item.description: C.H. Robinson Worldwide CEO Dave Bozeman expects more consolidation among US freight brokers as higher diesel prices squeeze smaller players, he told Reuters, a day after the company agreed to buy RXO for $5.8 billion.
item.dc:creator: Apratim Sarkar
item.content:encoded: C.H. Robinson Worldwide (CHRW.O) CEO Dave Bozeman expects more consolidation among US freight brokers as higher diesel prices squeeze smaller players, he told Reuters, a day after the company agreed to buy RXO (RXO.N) for [USN:L4N45R0MP TEXT:"$5.8 billion"]. "We said we would be the consolidator," Bozeman said in an interview on Tuesday, citing the growing importance of scale and leverage. RXO fits C.H. Robinson's target profile, with strong gross margins and about $6.5 billion in business but weak operating margins. The company plans to lift RXO's margins to its own levels within two years, while adding last-mile and expedited services. A rise in diesel prices has pushed small carriers to a "stress point," forcing some capacity out of the market, Bozeman said, adding that freight rates should remain elevated into the holiday season. Asset-light C.H. Robinson is largely insulated, with diesel costs "very, very manageable," he said. Higher fuel and insurance costs will ultimately be passed on to shippers and consumers. The U.S. Energy Information Administration on Tuesday [USN:L6N45S116 TEXT:"raised"] its oil price forecasts for this year and next as global inventories fall rapidly and diesel markets remain tight amid the Iran war.

item.title: Michigan TE apologizes for leaked texts criticizing OC
item.description: Michigan tight end Zack Marshall posted an apology online Tuesday after making what he called "inappropriate comments" about his offensive coordinator in a group text that leaked.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Michigan tight end Zack Marshall posted an apology online Tuesday after making what he called "inappropriate comments" about his offensive coordinator in a group text that leaked. The messages, posted to X on Monday by the account College Transfer Portal, showed Marshall criticizing coordinator Jason Beck and the Wolverines' offense. "Last weekend, in the hours after we lost, I made some inappropriate comments that I regret," Marshall wrote in a social media post Tuesday. "The game is won and lost as a team, and I pointed fingers instead of taking accountability. I let my frustrations speak for me in an emotional moment. I apologize to my teammates and coaches for the unnecessary drama that this has caused." A spokesperson for the Michigan athletic department told ESPN that coaches have discussed the situation with Marshall. Marshall, who has not recorded a reception this season, told the other members of the group chat following the Wolverines' 20-14 loss to Minnesota on Saturday that Beck "had a meeting (with) all the (tight ends) and told us none of us are valuable to this offense." He referenced former head coach Sherrone Moore -- fired last December after an investigation determined he had an inappropriate relationship with a staffer -- and wrote Beck was "worse than Sherrone (minus the findings and other evidence)." "Basically our offense sucks cause if you blitz us we have no answers," Marshall also wrote. "... Also Beck tells (quarterback) Bryce (Underwood) where to go on every play and it gets strapped. Bryce is a good qb, Beck is a problem." Michigan is 3-2 and has started its Big Ten schedule with consecutive losses to Iowa and Minnesota, in which the Wolverines put up 19 and 14 points, respectively. Underwood, a former five-star recruit, has taken much of the blame as he has thrown four interceptions with a 59.3 percent completion rate. Beck, 46, is in his first season at Michigan as its offensive coordinator and quarterbacks coach after following new head coach Kyle Whittingham from Utah, where he held the same positions. He has previously coached offense and quarterbacks at New Mexico (2024) and Syracuse (2022-23). Marshall, a senior, had 16 receptions for 199 yards and one touchdown in 2025. --Field Level Media

item.title: Coreia do Norte adverte EUA sobre Taiwan, enquanto Kim promete apoio à Rússia
item.description: A Coreia do Norte criticou os Estados Unidos por suas vendas de armas e apoio militar a Taiwan, acusando Washington de alimentar as tensões no Estreito de Taiwan, informou a agência de notícias estatal KCNA na quarta-feira (horário local).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Coreia do Norte criticou os Estados Unidos por suas vendas de armas e apoio militar a Taiwan, acusando Washington de alimentar as tensões no Estreito de Taiwan, informou a agência de notícias estatal KCNA na quarta-feira (horário local). Um comentário da KCNA, citando o analista norte-coreano de assuntos internacionais Kim Myong Chol, afirmou que a política dos EUA em relação a Taiwan está prejudicando a paz e a estabilidade na região. O comentário condenou a presença de caças vendidos pelos EUA em Taiwan, afirmando que os EUA “devem pensar duas vezes se estão prontos para entrar em confronto direto com a poderosa potência nacional da República Popular da China pela segurança de Taiwan e se serão capazes de lidar com as consequências disso”. Os dois primeiros de um lote de 66 novos caças F-16V Block 70 encomendados em 2019 chegaram a Taiwan na semana passada, enquanto Taiwan enfrenta uma crescente ameaça militar de Pequim, que reivindica a ilha governada democraticamente como seu próprio território. Enquanto isso, o líder norte-coreano Kim Jong Un prometeu apoio contínuo à Rússia e aos seus esforços de guerra em uma mensagem de aniversário ao presidente Vladimir Putin, informou a KCNA na quarta-feira. Kim afirmou que Pyongyang continuaria a ampliar a cooperação no âmbito da parceria estratégica abrangente entre os países, dizendo estar convencido de que a “guerra sagrada pela justiça” da Rússia para defender sua soberania, interesses de segurança e integridade territorial terminaria em vitória, informou a KCNA. A mensagem não mencionou explicitamente a guerra da Rússia na Ucrânia. A Coreia do Norte enviou cerca de 14.000 a 15.000 soldados para apoiar a guerra da Rússia na Ucrânia desde 2024, segundo estimativas ucranianas e sul-coreanas. A Coreia do Norte e a Rússia fortaleceram significativamente seus laços desde que Putin e Kim assinaram um pacto de defesa mútua em junho de 2024.

item.title: Regulador brasileño aplaza la decisión sobre el contrato eléctrico de Enel en São Paulo
item.description: El regulador energético brasileño ANEEL aplazó el martes su decisión sobre si recomendar la rescisión anticipada de la licencia de la empresa italiana Enel para distribuir electricidad en el área metropolitana de São Paulo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El regulador energético brasileño ANEEL aplazó el martes su decisión sobre si recomendar la rescisión anticipada de la licencia de la empresa italiana Enel (ENEI.MI) para distribuir electricidad en el área metropolitana de São Paulo. La decisión se pospuso después de que uno de los consejeros de la ANEEL solicitara más tiempo para examinar el caso Dos de los cinco miembros del consejo de administración habían emitido su voto, ambos a favor de recomendar al Ministerio de Minas y Energía de Brasil la rescisión del contrato antes de su fecha de vencimiento en 2028 Los dos consejeros afirmaron que recomendar la rescisión es el último recurso disponible para la ANEEL, después de que los acuerdos de mejora del rendimiento y las multas resultaran insuficientes Enel está en el punto de mira en Brasil después de que unas condiciones meteorológicas extremas dejaran sin electricidad a millones de hogares y empresas entre 2023 y 2025 en São Paulo La empresa afirma que el procedimiento se centra en un único fenómeno meteorológico ocurrido en 2025 y no tiene en cuenta las mejoras realizadas durante los últimos dos años y medio La empresa también cuestiona algunos aspectos de la metodología de la ANEEL para calcular los tiempos de interrupción del servicio y de reconexión de los clientes

item.title: BYD will struggle to do a better Toyota impression
item.description: Founder Wang Chuanfu wants to overtake the world’s largest automaker. His $102 bln electric car group already resembles the Japanese giant’s younger self. But becoming a true doppelganger means charming hostile markets, quintupling overseas factories, and doubling down on trucks.
item.dc:creator: Katrina Hamlin
item.content:encoded: BYD (002594.SZ) , short for “build your dreams”, may not fulfill those of its founder. Wang Chuanfu told shareholders at an investor meeting in June the Shenzhen company aims to [USN:L1N42I02P TEXT:"become"] the world’s largest carmaker by 2030 – a plan that entails overtaking Toyota (7203.T) , which sold roughly 11 million cars last year. BYD is retracing the path the Japanese giant took in its early decades, but the next steps are harder to follow. Wang has long watched Toyota. Early BYD models were eerily similar to the Japanese marque’s bestsellers: the 2008 F3 sedan was hailed as a “ Corolla ripoff ”. In some ways, the company itself has become a dead ringer for the young Toyota. It has risen by pushing an affordable alternative to fuel-intensive gas guzzlers, at a time when geopolitics and climate change make cutting dependency on oil a priority for both policymakers and consumers. Decades ago, Toyota also won over drivers with efficient engines and lighter models. In the wake of the 1970s oil crisis, its Corolla outshone heavier, thirstier cars made by American rivals such as Ford Motor (F.N) . BYD leads in its home market, with 12% share as of August according to Shanghai consultancy Automobility, just as Toyota dominates in Japan. It’s driving exports to the limit too – they make up nearly half its sales, riling China’s trade partners. That also echoes Toyota: By 1980, the majority of its cars ended up overseas, prompting the US and the then European Community to negotiate import quotas with Tokyo. This combination of commercial aggression and technical prowess saw BYD car deliveries reach 4.6 million in 2025, on a par with Toyota's annual volumes in 1997. However, their paths may yet diverge. Toyota matured in a very different environment. While the global vehicle market expanded by about 20 million units over the 1980s and 1990s to reach nearly 60 million at the turn of the century – ample space for the Japanese group to grow into - the next decade could see slower or even stagnant growth. If you sell 10 million cars, someone else loses 10 million, as CLSA analyst Xiao Feng puts it. The world’s auto producing nations are upping their guard against newcomers. Drivers can buy Toyotas in around 170 different markets. BYD has entered about 120 countries and territories. But it has no or limited access to three of the world’s top ten auto markets, namely the US - Toyota's largest source of sales - plus India and Japan. Together, they accounted for some 22 million passenger vehicles last year, roughly a quarter of the industry total. Changing the status quo is beyond Wang’s control. Friendlier nations let millions of Chinese cars in. But many are now raising the price of entry. The EU, the world’s second-largest market for electric cars, has imposed an additional 17% duty on BYD’s imports from the People’s Republic. Brussels is under pressure to consider [USN:L6N45A06Z TEXT:"more mechanisms"] to control import volumes, particularly for hybrid powertrains. Brazil introduced 35% tariffs in July. Mexico, Russia and Thailand all have levies in place, and the UK [USN:FWN45Q005 TEXT:"may"] soon introduce duties too. Meanwhile, Beijing itself is signaling [USN:L6N44U09P TEXT:"unease"] as passenger vehicle exports [USN:L6N43H04Q TEXT:"break records"] and look set to top 10 million units this year, angering trade partners. Three ministries have thrown their weight behind new guidelines for exporting automakers, urging them to respect local regulations and avoid disruptive competition. Authorities could take more concrete steps, such as removing a generous 13% export tax rebate. On top of that, domestic sales are slowing. China’s dealer association expects a double-digit percentage drop this year, and Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) warned investors the market could contract by 20%. All of that complicates BYD’s efforts to shift the roughly 6 million cars it is capable of churning out in China each year, as estimated by Automobility founder Bill Russo. Making cars abroad – as Toyota started doing in 1959 – circumvents tariffs and other roadblocks. BYD has announced overseas factories across Hungary, Thailand, Brazil, Uzbekistan and Indonesia, whose combined capacity would amount to nearly 1 million units a year, according to Citi research. It’s also [USN:L8N4581FT TEXT:"looking into"] deals to take advantage of existing production sites, Reuters reported, which should be faster than building. It is possible to ramp up international supply chains quickly – Toyota itself doubled overseas production to 4 million in just five years between 2002 and 2007. But Wang would need to at least quintuple capacity outside China to about 5 million to reach his goal of surpassing Toyota’s current volumes, assuming China sales stay flat. There are other ways to top up volumes here and there. One more Toyota trick BYD is trying is expanding its product range. Just like 1980s Toyota, which launched the Lexus marque in 1989, it has successfully branched into premium products: the high-end Denza and Fangchengbao brands accounted for more than 10% of sales as of the first quarter, according to analysts at Sunwah Kingsway. Cutting-edge technology like its fast-charging batteries, which can charge to 97% capacity in under 9 minutes, and sophisticated digital cockpits could help it wrestle new buyers from incumbents – including Toyota. Trucks and vans present another promising area. For the first half of the Toyota group’s existence, up until the 1960s, commercial vehicles accounted for more than half of export volumes. Wang is only just getting started on that front. At BYD, commercial vehicles – mostly buses – contributed less than 2% of total sales so far this year. He has an opportunity to do much more: e-truck deliveries reached 30% of sales in China in 2025, compared with almost none in 2021, and exports have spiked since the Iran war broke out. The company’s commercial vehicle sales are growing fast, rising 28% in the first three quarters, when BYD's car sales fell 4%. Last month it also announced a plan to [USN:L8N4560Y9 TEXT:"make"] heavy-duty trucks in Europe. It’s much less experienced than beefier rivals like Sany Heavy, which is expanding rapidly. But it might take share from legacy groups that remain more focused on gasoline. BYD is doing a remarkably good impression of a young Toyota, and Wang is still finding new ways to mimic the world’s largest carmaker. But catching up with the $220 billion juggernaut looks like a tall order, especially by 2030. That doesn’t mean Chair Akio Toyoda can rest easy: the Japanese group will be a prime target as its Chinese twin hunts for more market share. Follow Katrina Hamlin on Bluesky and LinkedIn

item.title: Anthropic disponibiliza seus modelos de IA mais poderosos para mais equipes de segurança
item.description: A Anthropic está ampliando um programa que permite que profissionais de segurança digital credenciados testem seus modelos de inteligência artificial mais poderosos com menos medidas de proteção, depois que sua iniciativa “Projeto Glasswing” ajudou a identificar mais de 100 mil vulnerabilidades de software neste ano.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Anthropic está ampliando um programa que permite que profissionais de segurança digital credenciados testem seus modelos de inteligência artificial mais poderosos com menos medidas de proteção, depois que sua iniciativa “Projeto Glasswing” ajudou a identificar mais de 100 mil vulnerabilidades de software neste ano. Os parceiros no Glasswing, uma iniciativa que visa proteger os softwares mais críticos do mundo, identificaram pelo menos 129 mil vulnerabilidades confirmadas entre abril e julho. A própria varredura de código aberto da Anthropic encontrou mais 5.500 entre abril e outubro. Mais de 33.000 foram classificadas até o momento como críticas ou de alta gravidade. A Anthropic afirmou que os números provavelmente estão subestimados e espera que o impacto real seja pelo menos cinco vezes maior, já que os dados provêm de uma pesquisa com um número limitado de parceiros. O Programa de Verificação Cibernética (CVP), reformulado e anunciado nesta terça-feira, combina dois programas que a Anthropic vem executando nos últimos seis meses. O primeiro, o Glasswing, proporcionou às organizações que protegem softwares críticos acesso ao Claude Mythos, a família de modelos da Anthropic com maior capacidade. O segundo, o CVP original, concedeu a equipes de segurança aprovadas acesso com restrições reduzidas aos modelos Claude Opus e Sonnet. O lançamento do Claude Mythos Preview pela empresa, em abril, gerou receios de que a IA atacar invadir softwares antes que eles fossem protegidos. O novo programa possui três níveis, cada um com seus próprios requisitos de verificação e controles de segurança. Todos os três incluem acesso ao Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Mythos 5.1 e modelos futuros. O nível “Defesa” abrange atividades como resposta a incidentes e análise de malware. Podem se inscrever equipes de segurança, operadores de infraestrutura crítica, mantenedores de código aberto e pesquisadores com histórico de vulnerabilidades relatadas. O nível “Red Team” acrescenta testes de penetração autorizados e simulações de ataques (red-teaming), mas apenas organizações podem se inscrever. O nível “Specialized” tem o menor número de restrições e é reservado a um pequeno grupo de organizações autorizadas a testar sistemas críticos para a segurança, como redes de energia, sistemas de voo e infraestrutura de transferências interbancárias. A Anthropic avalia cada membro em conjunto com o governo dos EUA, e os membros atuais do Glasswing passarão para esse nível. (Por Anzar Mehraj)

item.title: España remonta y vence 2-1 a Croacia; Kane brilla con Inglaterra en la Liga de Naciones
item.description: La selección española, campeona del mundo, se recuperó el martes para vencer 2-1 a Croacia con un doblete de Mikel Merino, un triunfo con el que amplió su racha invicta a 42 partidos y le aseguró una plaza en los cuartos de final de la Liga de Naciones.
item.dc:creator: Lori Ewing
item.content:encoded: La selección española, campeona del mundo, se recuperó el martes para vencer 2-1 a Croacia con un doblete de Mikel Merino, un triunfo con el que amplió su racha invicta a 42 partidos y le aseguró una plaza en los cuartos de final de la Liga de Naciones. En tanto, Inglaterra se impuso con facilidad 3-0 a la República Checa en el otro choque de la Liga A3 en el que su capitán Harry Kane marcó dos goles y dio la asistencia para el tercero en la noche en la que igualó el récord de 125 partidos internacionales de Peter Shilton. España lidera el grupo con 12 puntos, mientras que Inglaterra, que tiene prácticamente asegurada su plaza en cuartos de final, suma nueve. Croacia aparece con tres y los checos siguen sin sumar unidades. Tres días después de que Croacia sufriera una goleada 7-0 a manos de Inglaterra, estuvo a punto de dar la gran sorpresa ante España en Split cuando Ivan Perisic envió un cabezazo bien colocado en el minuto 17 para abrir el marcador. Pero el suplente Merino empató en el minuto 61 para ayudar a mantener la racha invicta de su selección, que se remonta a marzo de 2024. Croacia se quedó con 10 hombres cuando Perisic fue expulsado por doble amarilla en el minuto 79 y Merino completó la remontada de España 10 minutos más tarde con otro remate con la izquierda al ángulo de la portería. "Es un grupo de futbolistas fantástico que nunca bajan los brazos y partido tras partido nos sorprenden. En el segundo tiempo hemos sido claramente superiores y hemos remontado, es una victoria de muchísimo mérito", dijo el DT Luis de la Fuente. "Estoy muy orgulloso. Hablaría de ellos hasta acabar. Sabíamos la dureza que nos iba a exigir Croacia. En el primer tiempo sufrimos, pero lo maduramos", agregó. En Wembley, Thomas Tuchel se deshizo en elogios hacia su equipo tras alcanzar las 20 victorias en el menor número de partidos de cualquier seleccionador de Inglaterra en la historia: 26. "Creo que hemos hecho un partido muy bueno, muy fluido y, para ponerlo en contexto, es el cuarto partido en 11 o 12 días y creo que hemos dominado durante todo el encuentro", declaró Tuchel a ITV. "Creamos buenas ocasiones, marcamos goles preciosos y, sí, los suplentes estuvieron a la altura. Así que, de nuevo, una actuación muy buena y una victoria merecida". Inglaterra se adelantó en el minuto 27 gracias a un gol en propia puerta de Vladimir Coufal, tras un centro de Kane. A continuación, Kane coronó su noche histórica con un doblete, marcando justo antes del descanso y de nuevo en el minuto 57. De esta forma suma 91 conquistas con la selección inglesa. "Ha sido una noche perfecta para mí personalmente y también para el equipo", declaró Kane. "Ha sido una concentración dura, larga, y ha sido estupendo terminarla en Wembley; sin duda, una velada de la que estar muy orgulloso. Hoy se ha visto un fútbol fantástico por parte de Inglaterra". Los ocho equipos que terminen entre los dos primeros de los cuatro grupos de la Liga A disputarán las rondas eliminatorias a partir de marzo.

item.title: North Korea warns US over Taiwan while Kim pledges support for Russia
item.description: North Korea criticised the United States over its arms sales and military support for Taiwan, accusing Washington of fuelling tensions in the Taiwan Strait, state media KCNA said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: North Korea criticised the United States over its arms sales and military support for Taiwan, accusing Washington of fuelling tensions in the Taiwan Strait, state media KCNA said on Wednesday. A KCNA commentary citing North Korean international affairs analyst Kim Myong Chol said US policy on Taiwan was undermining peace and stability in the region. The commentary condemned the appearance of US-sold fighter aircraft in Taiwan, saying the US "should think twice whether it is ready to stand in frontal confrontation with the powerful national power of the People's Republic of China for the security of Taiwan and whether it can cope with its consequences." The first two of a batch of 66 new F-16V Block 70 fighter jets ordered in 2019 arrived in Taiwan [USN:L1N45O07H TEXT:"last week"], as Taiwan faces a rising military threat from Beijing which claims the democratically governed island as its own territory. Meanwhile, North Korean leader Kim Jong Un pledged continued support for Russia and its war effort in a birthday message to President Vladimir Putin, state media KCNA said on Wednesday. Kim said Pyongyang would continue to expand joint work under the countries' comprehensive strategic partnership, saying he was convinced that Russia's "sacred war of justice" to defend its sovereignty, security interests and territorial integrity would end in victory, KCNA said. The message did not explicitly mention Russia's war in Ukraine. North Korea has sent an estimated 14,000 to 15,000 troops to [USN:L1N45K11J TEXT:"support Russia's war"] in Ukraine since 2024, according to Ukrainian and South Korean estimates. North Korea and Russia have strengthened ties sharply since Putin and Kim signed a mutual defence pact in June 2024.

item.title: Christa Pike, sobrevivente de uma execução no Tennessee, está consciente e consegue falar, dizem advogados
item.description: Christa Pike, que sobreviveu a uma tentativa do Estado do Tennessee de executá-la por injeção letal na semana passada, recuperou a consciência e já está falando, informaram seus advogados em um comunicado nesta terça-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Christa Pike, que sobreviveu a uma tentativa do Estado do Tennessee de executá-la por injeção letal na semana passada, recuperou a consciência e já está falando, informaram seus advogados em um comunicado nesta terça-feira. Apesar dos ferimentos graves nos braços, Pike, de 50 anos, “ainda está algemada e acorrentada à cama”, onde “continua recebendo cuidados médicos intensivos”, escreveu sua equipe de defensores públicos. Pike, condenada à morte por seu papel no assassinato com tortura de uma colega de escola há três décadas, sobreviveu a uma tentativa fracassada de execução na noite de 30 de setembro na Instituição de Segurança Máxima de Riverbend, em Nashville, capital do Estado, e está hospitalizada desde então. O episódio encerrou uma saga de 30 anos que começou com o assassinato de uma estudante de um curso profissionalizante de 19 anos, Colleen Slemmer, por uma colega de classe com problemas emocionais cuja punição, segundo seus advogados, não levou em conta o trauma de infância que ela própria sofreu como vítima de abuso sexual, negligência e doença mental não tratada. Pike passou de ser a primeira mulher que o Tennessee tentou executar em mais de 200 anos para se tornar a primeira pessoa nos Estados Unidos de que se tem conhecimento a ter sobrevivido após a administração de medicamentos letais.

item.title: Eva Marie Saint, 'North by Northwest' movie star, dies at 102
item.description: Eva Marie Saint, the graceful blonde who delivered two of the most notable film performances of the 1950s in "On the Waterfront" with Marlon Brando and "North by Northwest" opposite Cary Grant, has died at the age of 102.
item.dc:creator: Will Dunham
item.content:encoded: Eva Marie Saint, the graceful blonde who delivered two of the most notable film performances of the 1950s in "On the Waterfront" with Marlon Brando and "North by Northwest" opposite Cary Grant, has died at the age of 102. Saint died of natural causes at her home in Los Angeles, a statement from her spokesperson said. Saint won an Oscar in her film debut for her portrayal of the virtuous Edie Doyle in director Elia Kazan's gritty 1954 drama "On the Waterfront," then changed direction as the spy Eve Kendall in director Alfred Hitchcock's 1959 thriller "North by Northwest." The New Jersey native worked with a procession of big-name directors and stars after honing her craft at the Actors Studio, Lee Strasberg's famed "method acting" school in New York. Otto Preminger hired her for "Exodus" (1960) with Paul Newman, while John Frankenheimer directed her in both "All Fall Down" (1962) with Warren Beatty and "Grand Prix" (1966) with James Garner. Vincente Minnelli directed Saint in "The Sandpiper" (1965) with Elizabeth Taylor and Richard Burton, while Norman Jewison cast her in the Cold War satire "The Russians Are Coming, The Russians Are Coming" (1966), an Oscar best picture nominee. Saint said her mentor was the great silent film actress Lillian Gish, who appeared with her in a 1953 production of the play "The Trip to Bountiful" that brought her to Kazan's attention. He picked Saint for "On the Waterfront" over Elizabeth Montgomery. The uncompromising film depicts the struggles of dockworkers on New York's rough waterfront. Brando played former boxer Terry Malloy, who runs afoul of a corrupt union but defies the odds to become a hero with the help of Saint's innocent but strong-willed Catholic girl Edie, who sees more good in him than he sees in himself. Saint was 30 at the time but was playing a schoolgirl. "On the Waterfront" won eight Academy Awards, including best picture, with Kazan named best director, Brando best actor and Saint best supporting actress. Saint was pregnant when she accepted her Oscar in March 1955. She gingerly walked to the stage, kissed the golden statuette and excitedly told the audience, "I may have the baby right here!" Two days after the ceremony, she gave birth to her first child, Darrell Hayden. 'AN EMPTY STOMACH' "North by Northwest" was a suspenseful espionage thriller, with Saint portraying a seductive spy in a tale of mistaken identity involving Grant's advertising man Roger Thornhill. Famous sequences include a crop-dusting plane pursuing Grant and a frantic chase involving Grant and Saint climbing the colossal U.S. presidential faces carved into Mount Rushmore. Hitchcock guided Grant and Saint through witty, suggestive dialogue that skirted the edge of what studios would allow at the time. One of Saint's lines - provocatively telling Grant "I never make love on an empty stomach" - was changed to the more benign "I never discuss love on an empty stomach." "North by Northwest" - like "On the Waterfront" often considered one of the greatest films ever made - received three Oscar nominations but won none. Saint was born on July 4, 1924, in New Jersey. Her early career was spent in live television productions in the formative years of the medium. She married veteran TV director Jeffrey Hayden in 1951 - a marriage that lasted until his death in 2016 - and they had two children. She starred in about 20 movies but turned down many roles to devote time to her family. Later in her career, Saint often returned to TV work. She won an Emmy Award in 1990 for her performance in the drama "People Like Us." She also took movie roles into her 80s including "Because of Winn-Dixie" (2005), "Winter's Tale" (2014) and "Superman Returns" (2006), a film in which Brando appeared posthumously using 1970s archive footage.

item.title: Corona beer maker Constellation Brands tops second-quarter estimates on resilient demand
item.description: Constellation Brands beat second-quarter estimates for profit and sales on Tuesday, as resilient demand for its beer such as Modelo Especial and Victoria helped offset challenges facing the alcohol industry in a soft spending environment.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Constellation Brands (STZ.N) beat second-quarter estimates for profit and sales on Tuesday, as resilient demand for its beer such as Modelo Especial and Victoria helped offset challenges facing the alcohol industry in a soft spending environment. The company also said it has bought SpikedAde, a vodka-based ready-to-drink (RTD) beverage company, for at least $75 million, as part of its strategy to expand into new demand areas and strengthen its position in the fast-growing RTD category. The company will pay $75 million at the closing of the deal for SpikedAde, and up to an additional $278 million over five years contingent to the brand's performance as well as Constellation's capital-allocation priorities. Constellation's beer business benefited from major sporting events this year, as the FIFA World Cup and NBA Finals spurred watch parties and social drinking occasions. Net sales for the quarter ended August 31 rose 6% to $2.63 billion, while analysts, on average, estimated $2.54 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. It earned $3.74 per share on an adjusted basis during the quarter, compared with the estimate of $3.56. Its wine and spirits business reported a 17% increase in quarterly net sales, while the beer segment posted a 5% rise. Constellation reaffirmed its fiscal 2027 forecast for adjusted earnings at $11.20 to $11.90 per share, and organic net sales in the range of 1% decline to 1% growth. The company lowered its annual operating margin forecast to 31% to 32%, from its prior forecast of 32% to 33%. Its shares were down 4.5% in extended trading. They have fallen about 16% so far this year. The company [USN:L4N40R1T1 TEXT:"withdrew"] its fiscal 2028 forecast in April, citing a volatile operating environment and a limited near-term visibility.

item.title: Campaña de Lula busca renovar su imagen antes de la segunda vuelta en Brasil
item.description: Tras una dura primera vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva busca replantear la estrategia de comunicación para llegar a los millones de brasileños que no votaron, según fuentes cercanas a la campaña.
item.dc:creator: Lisandra Paraguassu
item.content:encoded: Tras una dura primera vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva busca replantear la estrategia de comunicación para llegar a los millones de brasileños que no votaron, según fuentes cercanas a la campaña. Lula quedó casi dos puntos porcentuales —unos 2,2 millones de votos— por detrás del senador de derecha Flavio Bolsonaro en las elecciones del domingo, lo que deja al político de izquierda, que lleva tres mandatos, mal posicionado para el balotaje del 25 de octubre. Mientras los mercados celebraban las perspectivas de Bolsonaro, los aliados de Lula se reunieron el lunes en Brasilia para reorganizarse y planificar un cambio de imagen. En la reunión, Lula impulsó lo que internamente se denomina la "estrategia del miedo": recordar a los votantes los riesgos que, según él, supondría una presidencia de Bolsonaro para las prestaciones sociales . Fuentes cercanas a la campaña afirman que Lula achaca el fracaso a que el mensaje no ha llegado a suficientes jóvenes y mujeres. El Partido de los Trabajadores de Lula está tratando de ganarse a los más de 9 millones de votantes que apoyaron a candidatos menores, pero se centra principalmente en las 33 millones de abstenciones —una cifra récord— del domingo, lo que atribuye a la apatía más que a la oposición al octogenario líder. Un nuevo anuncio del PT en las redes sociales advierte que "algunas pérdidas son irreparables", mientras de una mano abierta salen volando trozos de papel en los que se enumeran programas gubernamentales, entre ellos uno para enviar médicos a zonas remotas y aumentos de las pensiones por encima de la inflación. La oficina de prensa de Bolsonaro no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. En una entrevista reciente, se comprometió a mantener el "Bolsa Família" —el programa insignia de transferencias monetarias de Brasil creado por Lula— y a permitir que los beneficiarios sigan acogiéndose a él incluso después de encontrar un trabajo formal o de crear una empresa. A menos de tres semanas del balotaje, el coordinador de campaña, Paulo Okamoto, afirmó que la campaña crearía una red de influencers de izquierda para impulsar la campaña en las redes sociales. El propio Lula podría suponer un obstáculo. A sus 80 años, no lleva teléfono y a menudo critica la cultura de las pantallas. Aunque el lunes prometió grabar más videos para las redes sociales —a los que él llama "selfies"—, Lula también afirmó que quiere conceder más entrevistas de radio antes de la segunda vuelta.

item.title: EUA prendem pessoa ligada a tiroteio em escola no Canadá, dizem autoridades
item.description: Autoridades norte-americanas prenderam nesta terça-feira, no Estado de Washington, uma pessoa que acusam de ter dado orientações e de ter se oferecido para transmitir ao vivo um tiroteio em massa fatal ocorrido no início deste ano no Canadá.
item.dc:creator: Daphne Psaledakis
item.content:encoded: Autoridades norte-americanas prenderam nesta terça-feira, no Estado de Washington, uma pessoa que acusam de ter dado orientações e de ter se oferecido para transmitir ao vivo um tiroteio em massa fatal ocorrido no início deste ano no Canadá. James Cody Bryant, de 30 anos, foi detido sob a acusação de conspiração para assassinar pessoas em um país estrangeiro, em conexão com o tiroteio em Tumbler Ridge, segundo o Departamento de Justiça. A acusação prevê pena que pode chegar à prisão perpétua. Bryant manteve contato repetido com a pessoa que disparou os tiros, Jesse Van Rootselaar, oferecendo orientação técnica, enviando dinheiro -- inclusive para a compra dos sapatos a serem usados durante o ataque -- e concordando em transmitir o evento ao vivo, afirmaram autoridades policiais. “James Cody Bryant tinha as informações e a capacidade de alertar as autoridades e chegou a discutir essa possibilidade com o atirador, mas optou por não fazê-lo, além de ter incentivado e oferecido assistência a um assassino”, disse o procurador federal interino do Distrito Oeste de Washington, Neil Floyd. Os autos do processo não indicaram imediatamente um advogado para Bryant. Nove pessoas, principalmente crianças, foram mortas no tiroteio na escola em Tumbler Ridge, na Colúmbia Britânica, em um dos piores tiroteios em massa do Canadá. Van Rootselaar, de 18 anos, que vinha sofrendo uma série de problemas de saúde mental, matou sua mãe e seu meio-irmão em casa antes de atirar e matar uma professora e cinco jovens alunos em sua antiga escola em Tumbler Ridge, um povoado de cerca de 2.400 habitantes nas Montanhas Rochosas canadenses, segundo a polícia. Van Rootselaar, que segundo a polícia nasceu homem, mas passou a se identificar como mulher, se matou em seguida. Bryant, que, segundo as autoridades, também teria nascido homem, mas se identificava como mulher, concordou em transmitir ao vivo o ataque e divulgá-lo “de forma a maximizar a notoriedade da atiradora”, disse Mike Herrington, agente especial responsável pelo FBI em Seattle. A transmissão ao vivo no Twitch foi interrompida após cerca de 20 segundos, informaram as autoridades. “Sem a lealdade equivocada de Bryant e sua disposição em operar a transmissão ao vivo, não sabemos ao certo se a atiradora teria levado o crime adiante”, disse Herrington. “Sabemos com certeza que a atiradora estava preocupada com a possibilidade de poucas pessoas assistirem à transmissão ao vivo sem a ajuda de Bryant e contava com isso para ampliar o alcance da transmissão, pois não tinha muitos seguidores nas redes sociais.”

item.title: Chevron to divest midstream assets in Bakken restructuring
item.description: Chevron said on Tuesday it had agreed to sell its stakes in Hess Midstream and DJ Basin crude oil midstream assets as part of a broader restructuring of its Bakken midstream agreements aimed at cutting costs and boosting returns.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chevron (CVX.N) said on Tuesday it had agreed to sell its stakes in Hess Midstream (HESM.N) and DJ Basin crude oil midstream assets as part of a broader restructuring of its Bakken midstream agreements aimed at cutting costs and boosting returns. The transaction would remove Hess Midstream from Chevron’s balance sheet, including about $3.7 billion of the unit’s debt. Chevron expects the deal to close by year-end and to record a one-time after-tax loss of about $3 billion to $4 billion. The revised agreements extend the Bakken contracts and are expected to reduce Chevron's Bakken unit midstream costs by approximately 50% Under the agreements, Chevron will also transfer its DJ Basin crude oil midstream assets to Hess Midstream In exchange, it will get $200 million in cash, longer Bakken contracts on revised terms and new DJ Basin midstream contracts Hess Midstream LP and Chevron will amend their existing Bakken commercial agreements, further aligning long-term interests by reducing tariffs while extending the terms of the agreements through 2045, Hess said in a statement Chevron is expected to move from three to two drilling rigs in the Bakken in December 2026, the Hess statement added

item.title: Polícia reprime protesto da oposição indiana que exigia renúncia do chefe da comissão eleitoral
item.description: A polícia indiana dispersou, nesta terça-feira, um protesto da oposição e deteve temporariamente o líder do Partido do Congresso, Rahul Gandhi, e outros parlamentares, depois que eles exigiram a renúncia do presidente da comissão eleitoral, alegando que as listas eleitorais haviam sido alteradas para favorecer o governo.
item.dc:creator: Saurabh Sharma, Shilpa Jamkhandikar, Sakshi Dayal
item.content:encoded: A polícia indiana dispersou, nesta terça-feira, um protesto da oposição e deteve temporariamente o líder do Partido do Congresso, Rahul Gandhi, e outros parlamentares, depois que eles exigiram a renúncia do presidente da comissão eleitoral, alegando que as listas eleitorais haviam sido alteradas para favorecer o governo. Dezenas de parlamentares liderados por Gandhi marcharam até a sede da Comissão Eleitoral da Índia (ECI, na sigla em inglês) antes de iniciar o protesto nas proximidades, sentados em colchões brancos sob uma árvore, que terminou à noite quando a polícia interveio e levou vários deles para dentro de viaturas. Partidos que se opõem ao governo do primeiro-ministro Narendra Modi, juntamente com membros do popular movimento juvenil “barata”, iniciaram protestos contra o presidente da Comissão Eleitoral, Gyanesh Kumar, depois que o jornal Indian Express noticiou divergências dentro da comissão no mês passado sobre a atualização das listas eleitorais. As manifestações representam um desafio político para Modi na metade de seu terceiro mandato, poucos meses depois que protestos semelhantes forçaram a renúncia de seu ministro da Educação devido ao vazamento de questões de provas. As divergências relatadas sobre as listas eleitorais e os procedimentos de registro alimentaram preocupações quanto à neutralidade da comissão, liderada por um nomeado pelo governo de Modi. A Reuters não conseguiu verificar a reportagem do jornal. "PERMANECEREMOS AQUI PELO TEMPO QUE FOR NECESSÁRIO" O Partido do Congresso e outros partidos afirmam que as listas eleitorais revisadas beneficiam Modi e seu partido. Kumar não se pronunciou sobre o assunto, mas a ECI e o Partido Bharatiya Janata (BJP), do governo de Modi, negaram as acusações. O porta-voz do BJP, Sudhanshu Trivedi, disse que os parlamentares do Partido do Congresso estavam enganando o país ao fazer alegações infundadas sobre a comissão eleitoral. A Polícia de Délhi informou que Gandhi, sua irmã Priyanka Vadra, também parlamentar, e outras pessoas foram detidos em conformidade com a lei para manter a paz e no interesse da segurança pública. Eles foram liberados posteriormente, informou o Partido do Congresso. Gandhi havia dito anteriormente aos repórteres que “os membros da comissão eleitoral terão que se reunir conosco” eventualmente. “Só queremos ir até os comissários eleitorais, fazer perguntas a eles e dizer que vocês roubaram votos”, afirmou. Ele e vários outros membros de seu partido, o Partido do Congresso, haviam se sentado em colchões dentro do complexo da emissora estatal, ao lado da ECI. “Ficaremos sentados o tempo que for preciso”, disse Gandhi antes das detenções pela polícia. A comissão eleitoral informou posteriormente que recebeu um pedido para se reunir com os parlamentares na noite desta terça-feira, mas o local sugerido por eles não estava de acordo com o protocolo da ECI. Os parlamentares rejeitaram a oferta da ECI de que um de seus funcionários recebesse o memorando, acrescentou a comissão em um comunicado.

item.title: Milho sobe em Chicago por preocupações com safra nos EUA
item.description: Os contratos futuros do milho negociados nos EUA subiram nesta terça-feira, depois que o Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA anunciou uma redução maior do que a esperada na condição da safra, o que alimentou preocupações de que a agência pudesse revisar para baixo suas projeções de produtividade.
item.dc:creator: Karl Plume
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros do milho negociados nos EUA subiram nesta terça-feira, depois que o Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA anunciou uma redução maior do que a esperada na condição da safra, o que alimentou preocupações de que a agência pudesse revisar para baixo suas projeções de produtividade. Os futuros da soja também subiram, já que a colheita foi retardada pelas chuvas recentes, que também geraram preocupações quanto à qualidade da safra e ao teor de óleo. Já o trigo subiu pela quarta sessão consecutiva, à medida que ataques a navios graneleiros no Mar Negro reforçaram os temores de interrupções nas exportações devido à guerra da Rússia contra a Ucrânia. Os comerciantes de grãos estão acompanhando as previsões meteorológicas para o Meio-Oeste, à medida que os agricultores intensificam a colheita após atrasos causados pelas chuvas na semana passada. Espera-se que grande parte da região permaneça seca na próxima semana. O USDA informou na segunda-feira que os agricultores dos EUA haviam colhido 23% de seu milho e 25% de sua soja até domingo, menos do que o esperado pelos analistas e abaixo do ritmo médio dos últimos cinco anos. A agência também reduziu, mais do que o esperado, sua estimativa de safras de milho classificadas em condições de boas a excelentes. "Parece que a qualidade da safra está se tornando uma questão cada vez mais importante. E não tenho certeza se todos estão convencidos, especialmente no caso do milho, de que os rendimentos sejam tão bons quanto o USDA afirma", disse Jim Gerlach, presidente da corretora de commodities A/C Trading, com sede em Indiana. O USDA deve atualizar suas perspectivas para as safras de milho e soja dos EUA em um relatório mensal de oferta e demanda na sexta-feira. O contrato de milho dezembro na bolsa de Chicago fechou com alta de 10,75 centavos, a US$5,08 o bushel, enquanto o contrato de soja novembro subiu 22,25 centavos, fechando a US$13,03 o bushel. O contrato de trigo dezembro da CBOT subiu 12 centavos, para US$7,0425 por bushel.

item.title: FICO cuts workforce by 15% as part of AI-driven restructuring
item.description: Credit-scoring giant Fair Isaac , known as FICO, said on Tuesday it would trim about 15% of its workforce as part of a broader restructuring and AI integration, becoming the latest US company to cut jobs as businesses automate tasks and redirect spending toward the technology.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Credit-scoring giant Fair Isaac (FICO.N) , known as FICO, said on Tuesday it would trim about 15% of its workforce as part of a broader restructuring and AI integration, becoming the latest US company to cut jobs as businesses automate tasks and redirect spending toward the technology. "This simplified structure will allow us to operate and bring innovations to market faster and create more value for our customers," FICO told Reuters in a statement. It did not specify the number of employees laid off. Fair Isaac had 3,811 employees at the end of September 2025, meaning the cuts could affect about 570 workers. It began notifying employees this week. It said it expects about $27 million in pre-tax charges in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, primarily related to severance. The plan is largely expected to be completed by the third quarter of fiscal 2027. REGULATORY PUSH WEIGHS ON SHARES Shares of the company — known for its FICO score, a measure of consumer credit risk widely used by banks, credit card issuers, mortgage lenders and auto loan providers — have plunged about 58% this year as US regulators seek to loosen its longstanding hold on mortgage credit scoring. Last month, the US Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA) [USN:S0N3ZQ02D TEXT:"directed"] mortgage finance giants Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac to allow all lenders to use VantageScore, a rival developed by Equifax, Experian and TransUnion, for credit scoring. FHFA director Bill Pulte also [USN:L4N45L1GO TEXT:"said"] Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac would adopt a single pricing grid for both VantageScore and FICO scores, effectively putting the rivals on equal footing and threatening FICO's dominance as the standard measure of consumer credit risk in mortgage lending.

item.title: Missouri freshman OL awaiting a heart transplant
item.description: Johnnie "DJ" Jones, a freshman offensive lineman at Missouri, is hospitalized in Florida awaiting a heart transplant.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Johnnie "DJ" Jones, a freshman offensive lineman at Missouri, is hospitalized in Florida awaiting a heart transplant. Tigers head coach Eli Drinkwitz announced the news on Tuesday while fighting back his emotions. Drinkwitz said the school's medical staff detected an issue with Jones' heart during an exam this summer. They later sent him to the Mayo Clinic in Jacksonville, Fla., for further testing. "Last week, we found out that Johnnie is now on a heart transplant list," Drinkwitz said. "He's in Mayo, and it's tough right now. Our thoughts and prayers are with him and his family as they go through this." The 6-foot-6, 315-pound tackle from Bradenton, Fla., was a consensus a four-star recruit in the Class of 2026 out of Venice High School. He chose Missouri over Georgia, Ole Miss, Florida, Florida State and others. Drinkwitz shouted out Jones following the Tigers' 45-17 upset of then-No. 8 Florida on Saturday. "DJ, we love you, man. We're praying for you. We'll see you," Drinkwitz said. "I know Johnnie was watching our game," Drinkwitz said Tuesday. "It's just hard. (He's) an 18-year-old with everything in front of him, and you're just not prepared for that kind of news. Our team wasn't prepared for that kind of news. We're praying for him, and I know a lot of Mizzou fans will hopefully join in that prayer because he does need help in a hurry." --Field Level Media

item.title: Açúcar bruto atinge maior cotação em 19 meses, enquanto café arábica sobe 4%
item.description: Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto na bolsa ICE atingiram a maior cotação em 19 meses nesta terça-feira, com previsão de mais chuvas no Brasil, principal produtor, enquanto os contratos futuros de café arábica registraram alta de 4%.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto na bolsa ICE atingiram a maior cotação em 19 meses nesta terça-feira, com previsão de mais chuvas no Brasil, principal produtor, enquanto os contratos futuros de café arábica registraram alta de 4%. AÇÚCAR * Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto fecharam em alta de 0,09 centavo, ou 0,4%, a 20,82 centavos por libra-peso, após atingirem uma máxima de 19 meses de 20,95 centavos. * Operadores afirmaram que mais chuvas são esperadas no Brasil nas próximas duas semanas, atrasando a moagem da cana e potencialmente reduzindo a produção de açúcar na região centro-sul para menos de 38 milhões de toneladas métricas. * As perspectivas têm se deteriorado constantemente nas últimas semanas, com uma pesquisa da Reuters divulgada no final de julho apresentando uma previsão consensual de 40 milhões de toneladas. * Eles observaram, no entanto, que a demanda no mercado físico estava fraca, com alguns acreditando que a alta nos preços havia sido exagerada. * O contrato de açúcar branco subiu 1,6%, para US$ 556,50 por tonelada métrica * A produção alemã de açúcar refinado a partir de beterraba na nova safra 2026/27 deve cair para cerca de 3,330 milhões de toneladas métricas, ante 4,421 milhões de toneladas na safra anterior, informou na terça-feira a associação da indústria açucareira alemã WVZ. CACAU * O cacau de Londres fechou em baixa de £151, ou 3,4%, a £4.231 por tonelada * Os corretores afirmaram que o mercado subiu acentuadamente nos últimos dias, passando de uma mínima de £3.805 em 1º de outubro para uma máxima de £4.428 na segunda-feira; portanto, um recuo moderado não era inesperado. * Eles observaram que as estatísticas de moagem do terceiro trimestre devem ser o foco nos próximos dias, com a divulgação dos dados da Europa e da América do Norte prevista para 15 de outubro * O contrato de cacau de Nova York registrou queda de 2,8%, para US$ 5.700 por tonelada CAFÉ * O contrato futuro de café arábica fechou com alta de 11,9 centavos, ou 4,1%, a US$3,0445 por libra-peso, após atingir uma máxima de três semanas de US$3,0645. * Há algumas preocupações com as temperaturas acima do normal nas regiões cafeeiras do Brasil para esta época do ano, apesar das chuvas generalizadas, segundo os corretores. * Eles também observaram que os estoques nas bolsas permaneceram baixos e que a valorização da moeda brasileira pode levar alguns produtores a restringir as vendas. * As exportações de café do Brasil em setembro foram elevadas, totalizando [USN:L1N45S0WG TEXT:"3,93 milhões de sacas"], o segundo maior volume já registrado para esse mês. * O preço do café robusta subiu 1,8%, para US$3.590 por tonelada. (Reportagem de Nigel Hunt e Marcelo Teixeira)

item.title: Tennessee execution survivor Christa Pike is conscious and speaking, lawyers say
item.description: Convicted killer Christa Pike, who survived Tennessee's effort to execute her by lethal injection last week, foiling the state's first attempt to put a woman to death in two centuries, has regained consciousness and is speaking, her lawyers said in a statement on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Steve Gorman
item.content:encoded: Convicted killer Christa Pike, who survived Tennessee's effort to execute her by lethal injection last week, foiling the state's first attempt to put a woman to death in two centuries, has regained consciousness and is speaking, her lawyers said in a statement on Tuesday. Despite severe injuries to her arms from the insertion of intravenous lines during the aborted execution last Wednesday, Pike, 50, is "still handcuffed and shackled" to her hospital bed while she remains under medical care, her team of public defense attorneys wrote. "Her prognosis remains unclear, but at a minimum we expect a long recovery," the lawyers' statement said, adding that a court hearing on Pike's case was scheduled for Wednesday in Davidson County Chancery Court. The hearing pertains to her lawyers' request for a court order to preserve evidence from the failed execution they said would show the Tennessee Department of Correction violated Pike's constitutional rights by subjecting her to cruel and unusual punishment, a spokesperson said. She was not expected to appear for the proceeding. Pike, sentenced to death for her role as a teenager in the torture-murder of 19-year-old schoolmate Colleen Slemmer three decades ago, [USN:L1N45M031 TEXT:"survived"] the execution attempt on the night of September 30 at Riverbend Maximum Security Institution in Nashville, the state capital. She has been hospitalized since then. Her lawyers said on Friday their client remained unconscious, critically ill and hooked to a ventilator to breathe, as doctors labored to clear the drug pentobarbital from her system. "Against all odds, Christa Pike is conscious, speaking and continues to receive critical medical care," they wrote on Tuesday. Pike's petition for clemency, denied last week by Republican Governor Bill Lee, argued her death sentence had failed to properly account for Pike's own childhood trauma as the victim of sexual abuse, neglect and untreated mental illness. Long the only woman on death row in the state, Pike also has endured nearly 30 years of solitary confinement, her lawyers say. Pike went from being the first woman Tennessee had tried to put to death since the early 19th century to becoming the first person in the United States known to have survived after execution drugs were administered. Death penalty opponents said the incident exposed the inherent barbarity of executions. It also highlighted the difficulties of carrying out lethal injections while respecting constitutional prohibitions on cruel and unusual punishment. LETHAL INJECTION GONE AWRY Pike's attorneys and journalists who witnessed the execution attempt described it as roughly 2-1/2 hours of disarray and prolonged distress for her as Correction Department personnel struggled to administer two doses of pentobarbital intravenously. Pike was heard gasping, crying, whimpering and breathing loudly through much of the procedure, at one point saying, "My arm feels like it's about to burst open." The bungled attempt to establish intravenous lines left both of Pike's arms "swollen, burned and blistered," the apparent result of the pentobarbital, a highly alkaline and caustic substance, seeping into the tissues under her skin, her lawyers said in court filings. The lawyers accused state officials of having shrugged off prior warnings from Pike's doctors that her small veins and a blood disorder would make placing IV lines especially difficult. In the midst of the procedure, Pike's lawyers filed an emergency court motion to halt it. By then, prison officials had ceased their execution efforts and called an ambulance, according to court records. The night of the execution attempt, the Correction Department defended its handling of the situation, saying it had "followed every step of the state's lawful, established execution protocol." But agency commissioner Frank Strada [USN:L6N45P05N TEXT:"has resigned"] and will leave his post this month, the governor announced on Saturday. Lee had previously ordered a suspension of any scheduled executions for the rest of the year and a third-party review of what happened in Pike's case. 30-YEAR SAGA Two days before Pike was due to meet her fate, Lee rejected a petition seeking to commute her death penalty to a life prison term without the possibility of parole. Pike was 18 in January 1995 when she, her 17-year-old boyfriend, Tadaryl Shipp, and a third companion lured Slemmer into a wooded area on the University of Tennessee campus in Knoxville and killed her. The gruesome nature of the slaying, which involved Shipp carving the shape of a pentagram in the victim's chest and Pike bashing Slemmer in the head with a chunk of asphalt, then taking a piece of her skull as a souvenir, drew intense media coverage at the time. Trial testimony indicated Pike viewed Slemmer as a rival for her boyfriend's affections. Pike and Shipp confessed to the killing, and both were convicted of first-degree murder. Pike was sentenced to death, while Shipp received a life sentence with the possibility of parole. Their co-defendant, Shadolla Peterson, who was 18 at the time of the murder and had acted as a lookout for the other two, testified for the prosecution and received probation.

item.title: Black Hills plans $1.8 billion investment to power Google's data center
item.description: Black Hills Corp said on Tuesday it signed agreements to power a proposed Google data center in Cheyenne, Wyoming, and plans to spend $1.8 billion from 2027 to 2029 on new generation capacity, as tech firms race to secure electricity for power-hungry AI data centers.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Black Hills Corp (BKH.N) said on Tuesday it signed agreements to power a proposed Google data center in Cheyenne, Wyoming, and plans to spend $1.8 billion from 2027 to 2029 on new generation capacity, as tech firms race to secure electricity for power-hungry AI data centers. Black Hills said it will build 564 megawatts (MW) of new generation capacity for the Cheyenne project The project is expected to draw on a 2.7-gigawatt (GW) resource mix, including reserve margins, with power deliveries set to begin in late 2027 and peak load expected in 2030 Black Hills will supply up to 590 MW from the grid, mostly from a new gas plant at its Cheyenne Prairie Generating Station and manage about 2.1 GW of third-party resources in Wyoming through a privately managed microgrid The South Dakota-based utility expects the project to add about $150 million to its net income by 2030 The agreement requires Google to cover the full cost of supplying electricity to the data center, preventing those expenses from being passed on to other utility customers Separately, Google (GOOGL.O) also signed a 3.59-GW power contract with [USN:L6N45S0XB TEXT:"Constellation Energy"] (CEG.O) , which will invest more than $4.3 billion in its fleet In [USN:L4N3UB0OI TEXT:"August"] last year, Black Hills agreed to merge with NorthWestern Energy (NWE.O) in an all-stock deal to create a $15.4 billion regulated electric and natural gas utility

item.title: Spain rally to beat Croatia, Kane shines for England in Nations League
item.description: World champions Spain recovered to beat Croatia 2-1 on Tuesday, with Mikel Merino scoring twice to extend their unbeaten run to 42 matches and seal a place in the Nations League quarter-finals on the final night of the fourth round of group-stage action.
item.dc:creator: Lori Ewing
item.content:encoded: World champions Spain recovered to beat Croatia 2-1 on Tuesday, with Mikel Merino scoring twice to extend their unbeaten run to 42 matches and seal a place in the Nations League quarter-finals on the final night of the fourth round of group-stage action. England eased to a 3-0 victory over the Czech Republic in the other League A3 match, with captain Harry Kane scoring twice and setting up the third on the night he equalled Peter Shilton's national appearance record with his 125th cap. Spain top the group with 12 points, while England, who all but clinched a quarter-final spot, have nine, and Croatia are on three. The Czechs are still without a point. Three days after Croatia were trounced 7-0 by visitors England, they threatened a major upset against Spain in Split when Ivan Perisic sent a well-placed header into the bottom-left corner in the 17th minute to give them the lead. But substitute Merino equalised in the 61st to help preserve his nation's undefeated streak stretching back to March 2024 when he found space in the middle of the box before firing a left-footed shot into the bottom corner. Croatia were reduced to 10 men when Perisic was sent off for a second yellow card in the 79th minute and Merino completed Spain's comeback 10 minutes later with another left-footed finish into the corner of the net. "I would spend the entire press conference thanking my players," said Spain boss Luis de la Fuente, who started five Barcelona players. "We knew that the match was going to get like this, but we've managed to understand it very well. We haven't dropped our arms." At Wembley, Thomas Tuchel was full of praise for his team after reaching 20 wins in the fewest games of any England manager in the nation's history, with 26. "I think we played a very good match, very fluid and, to put it into context, it's the fourth match in 11 or 12 days and I think we dominated through the whole match," Tuchel told ITV. "Very focused, created some good opportunities, got some beautiful goals and, yeah, subs were strong. So a very good performance again and a deserved win." HISTORIC NIGHT FOR KANE The World Cup bronze medallists went ahead after 27 minutes through a Vladimir Coufal own goal, with Kane providing the cross. Kane then marked his historic night with a pair of goals, striking just before the break when Elliot Anderson launched a long ball to Morgan Rogers, whose first-time cross from the right found the 33-year-old in the box for a clinical finish. Kane completed his double in the 57th when he rose to head Lewis Hall's corner home from the back post to bag his 91st goal for England. "It was the perfect night for me personally and also the team," Kane said. "It's been a tough camp, a long camp, and it's been nice to finish it off at Wembley, a really proud evening for sure. "You saw some fantastic football from England out there today." Elsewhere, Slovenia beat Scotland 2-1 with Aljosa Matko and Danijel Sturm scoring in the second half to cancel out Ryan Christie's 31st minute opener in League B1. Switzerland's Fabian Rieder, Johan Manzambi and Dan Ndoye scored in a 3-0 win over North Macedonia in the other game in that group. The Swiss have 12 points ahead of Slovenia on seven, Scotland with four and North Macedonia on none. The final two rounds of the group stage will be played in the November international break. The eight teams finishing in the top two of the four League A groups will play in the knockout rounds beginning in March.

item.title: Colombia reserva 19,9 millones de hectáreas adicionales de nuevas áreas para contratos de petróleo y gas: ANH
item.description: Colombia reservó 19,9 millones de hectáreas adicionales destinadas a la asignación de nuevas áreas para contratos de petróleo y gas, informó el martes la Agencia Nacional de Hidrocarburos (ANH).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Colombia reservó 19,9 millones de hectáreas adicionales destinadas a la asignación de nuevas áreas para contratos de petróleo y gas, informó el martes la Agencia Nacional de Hidrocarburos (ANH). De ese total, 4,7 millones de hectáreas corresponden a proyectos costa afuera, el segmento más amplio del plan, según la resolución firmada por la entidad el 2 de octubre. La medida comprende áreas ubicadas en 12 cuencas sedimentarias, continentales y costa afuera, precisó la ANH. La ampliación del denominado Mapa de Tierras hace parte del plan del Gobierno del presidente Abelardo De La Espriella para reactivar la firma de nuevos contratos de exploración y producción de hidrocarburos, suspendidos por su antecesor, el izquierdista Gustavo Petro. "El propósito de la reserva es adelantar los estudios que permitan definir los tipos de procesos de selección, los términos de referencia o reglas, la modalidad de negocio jurídico y las condiciones contractuales con los que eventualmente se ofrecerán estas áreas a los interesados", dijo la ANH en un comunicado. "Estos estudios técnicos aportarán información de cada cuenca y permitirán identificar oportunidades exploratorias que puedan ofrecerse al mercado en futuros procesos de asignación de áreas", explicó la agencia. A finales de septiembre, el presidente del grupo energético colombiano Ecopetrol, Joaquín Gutiérrez, anunció que avanzará en [USN:L1N45I00P TEXT:"proyectos convencionales y no convencionales"], implementará el fracking y continuará explorando yacimientos costa afuera para incrementar las reservas de hidrocarburos. Ecopetrol, controlada en un 88,5% por el Estado colombiano, genera la mayoría de la producción de petróleo del país y es propietaria de las dos principales refinerías, así como de la mayor parte de la red de oleoductos y poliductos.

item.title: Trading Day: Running with the bulls
item.description: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq hit record highs on Tuesday as a pause in the bond market sell-off and steady oil prices paved the way for a tech- and AI-led wave of buying, with investors entering the third-quarter earnings season with a great sense of optimism.

item.content:encoded:
The S&P 500 and Nasdaq hit [USN:L6N45S0IV TEXT:"record highs"] on Tuesday as a pause in the bond market sell-off and steady oil prices paved the way for a tech- and AI-led wave of buying, with investors entering the third-quarter earnings season with a great sense of optimism. In [USN:L6N45R0WK TEXT:"my column today"], I look at the potential red flags in the US bond market from Treasury's regular debt auctions. Yields are rising, and that's not necessarily a sign of stress, but big "tails" at these auctions are. Investors will be scrutinizing the underlying data in these sales extremely closely. Today's Talking Points: Imbalances The Trump administration's desire to see the [USN:L1N45R0RR TEXT:"US trade deficit"] narrow meaningfully — or even at all — is frustrated yet again. Figures on Tuesday showed that record imports in August pushed the trade gap out to its widest in 17 months. Tariffs, trade wars, re-shoring, and "trillions" of investment from abroad (according to Trump), are all failing, certainly by this metric. While record imports point to robust consumer demand and spending, the deficit they deliver cuts GDP growth. The Atlanta Fed's GDPNow model estimate of Q3 growth was trimmed a tenth of one percent to 3.7% on Tuesday after the trade data. Against the backdrop of China's record-breaking trade surplus, the US deficit is also a reminder of the risks posed by widening global imbalances. Crude awakening The US-Iran war is now in its eighth month, and the Strait of Hormuz has ostensibly been closed for that entire time too. As such, it's a surprise that oil and related energy prices aren't even higher than they are. The reason oil is $100 a barrel and not $150 or even $200 seems to be the supply of crude flowing from the region is far greater than many had thought. Vitol's CEO on Tuesday said up to [USN:S8N3NH0L4 TEXT:"14 million barrels"] a day are being shipped from the Middle East. Which is just as well, because the world has nearly [USN:L6N45S103 TEXT:"burned through"] its stockpile buffer, according to industry executives. Governments and international agencies are releasing reserves into the market but they are drops in the ocean — the IEA is [USN:L8N45S0QH TEXT:"preparing to release"] 100 million barrels of crude and diesel, but that barely covers one day of global oil demand. Once reserves run dry and the war is still raging, then what? Just a minute The Federal Reserve on Wednesday publishes the minutes of its September 15-16 policy meeting. They will be closely scrutinized, as always, for signals about policymakers' thinking on the likely path for rates in the coming months. But it is already looking like the hawkish posture behind the unanimous vote to raise rates three weeks ago may already be fraying. Several officials, beginning with New York Fed President John Williams, have indicated they are in no rush to follow up with another hike immediately. The incoming hard economic data seem to support that stance too — PCE inflation and non-farm payrolls were both softer than expected. Rates futures currently show an 80-20 chance of no change later this month, compared with a 70-30 probability of a hike only a week ago. What could move markets tomorrow? item.title: Preço da arroba do boi gordo em SP tem o maior valor nominal, aponta Cepea
item.description: O preço da arroba do boi gordo no mercado paulista marcou o maior patamar nominal da história na segunda-feira, a R$372,95, com alta de 7,8% em relação ao início do mês anterior, devido a uma baixa oferta de animais para abate e também à firme demanda interna, disse um especialista do Cepea nesta terça-feira.
item.dc:creator: Roberto Samora
item.content:encoded: O preço da arroba do boi gordo no mercado paulista marcou o maior patamar nominal da história na segunda-feira, a R$372,95, com alta de 7,8% em relação ao início do mês anterior, devido a uma baixa oferta de animais para abate e também à firme demanda interna, disse um especialista do Cepea nesta terça-feira. O pesquisador Thiago Bernardino de Carvalho, do Centro de Estudos Avançados em Economia Aplicada (Cepea), da Esalq/USP, explicou que a oferta menor de animais se deve, entre outros fatores, às incertezas geradas pelas [USN:L6N45M0JE TEXT:"tarifas"] impostas pela China. "Isso não estimulou muitos confinadores a colocar gado no coxo, principalmente nesse período entre junho e julho... daí isso se reflete nesse gado que estaria pronto agora", afirmou ele. A China começou a cobrar uma tarifa adicional de 55% sobre as remessas de carne bovina do Brasil a partir de 1º de outubro, depois que o país atingiu sua cota anual de 1,1 milhão de toneladas. Mas antes disso os embarques brasileiros ao maior mercado despencaram nos últimos meses, com exportadores buscando evitar a tarifa. "Esse cenário de incerteza em relação à compra da China fez com que a oferta ficasse mais ajustada", completou Carvalho. Além disso, as fortes exportações de gado vivo pelo Brasil em 2026 também ajudam a reduzir a oferta de animais para a indústria local. "É um animal jovem, mas ajuda a dinamizar a questão de oferta, precificação do bezerro, do boi magro. Então, a pressão também de preços mais altos da reposição empurra o preço da arroba", disse. Do lado da demanda, o pesquisador destacou que os preços no mercado interno brasileiro estão perto dos maiores patamares já vistos. "O mercado brasileiro está comprador...", disse ele, ponderando que, apesar de problemas econômicos, como alta inadimplência, este ano também teve eleição e Copa do Mundo, eventos que impulsionam a demanda. "Tudo isso ajuda a entender essa dinâmica. A gente tem mais dinheiro fluindo no mercado", afirmou ele, lembrando que o padrão alimentar também mudou, com consumidores buscando mais proteína animal. No exterior, apesar dos limites para embarques à China, o Brasil seguiu exportando bons volumes para outros destinos. Com relação ao embargo da União Europeia a partir de setembro, Carvalho observou que europeus pagam bem, mas acabam comprando poucos tipos de cortes. Entre os países que têm ampliado as importações do produto brasileiro, ele destacou os Estados Unidos. RETORNO DA CHINA O país asiático, maior importador do produto brasileiro, estabeleceu salvaguardas no final do ano passado visando preservar a indústria local, colocando uma tarifa adicional para compras fora da cota em 2026, 2027 e 2028. Para o ano que vem, a cota com a tarifa menor de 12% envolverá 1,128 milhão de toneladas, e a expectativa é de que os [USN:L1N4590LY TEXT:"embarques"] para o preenchimento de tais volumes já comecem em novembro, segundo avaliação da associação da indústria Abiec. Carvalho disse que ao final de setembro já houve alguma movimentação de negócios para novas vendas de carne bovina à China, que devem ser intensificadas a partir de agora, após o feriado chinês nesta semana.

item.title: Eagles RT Lane Johnson retires to focus on mental health
item.description: Philadelphia Eagles right tackle Lane Johnson retired Tuesday after 14 seasons and two Super Bowl championships.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Philadelphia Eagles right tackle Lane Johnson retired Tuesday after 14 seasons and two Super Bowl championships. Johnson, 36, who missed Sunday's loss against the Los Angeles Rams for personal reasons, said he wants to focus on his mental health. "I deeply wanted to gut it out for one more year; to take the field with my brothers for one last season. But after a lot of reflection, I've realized that my personal and family priorities have changed. Right now it is critical that I focus on my mental health," he posted on social media. "I owe it to my teammates, coaches, the organization and the fans to have my head and heart 100 percent in the game. And right now my heart is telling me that it's time to say goodbye to football." The six-time Pro Bowl selection and two-time first-team All-Pro started all 186 games he played with the Eagles, including playoffs, since Philadelphia drafted him with the fourth overall pick in 2013. "Lane Johnson is an all-time Eagle and one of the best players ever to play his position in NFL history," Eagles owner Jeffrey Lurie said in a statement. "Lane was a major contributor to our team success for 14 seasons, helping to bring two Super Bowl championships and many other memorable moments to the organization and the City of Philadelphia. "Lane excelled under multiple coaching staffs, maintaining an elite level of play throughout his entire career. His combination of talent, strength, athleticism and intelligence made him a truly unique player in this league. And there is no doubt in my mind that one day he will be named to the Pro Football Hall of Fame. "Beyond his on-field accomplishments, Lane has done a tremendous amount to give back to the community through his numerous charitable endeavors. The courage he has shown using his own personal experiences to advocate for mental health awareness has undoubtedly saved lives.
